home.title: JISR — a bridge from screening to real human support
home.intro: JISR (“bridge” in Arabic) closes the gap between a positive mental-health screen and real human follow-up. It is not a chatbot and not a mood tracker: validated screening tools, fixed safety rules, and a human care navigator.
home.note: This is a screening, not a diagnosis. All data in this prototype is synthetic.
home.residentDesc: Take a PHQ-9 or GAD-7 screen, see what your result means, and get matched to the right level of support.
home.navigatorDesc: Human care navigator queue: risk-first ordering, SLA timers, overdue detection, outreach logging.
home.healthDesc: Gap Finder: where follow-up falls through, by language, age, gender, nationality and area.

screen.freeTextTitle: Anything else you want to share? (optional)
screen.freeTextHint: Free text is checked by fixed safety rules. You can skip this.

items.0: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
items.2: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
items.3: Feeling tired or having little energy
items.5: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
items.6: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
items.7: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed. Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
items.8: Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way

items.0: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
items.1: Not being able to stop or control worrying
items.2: Worrying too much about different things
items.4: Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
items.6: Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen

result.meansBody: your answers fall in the {band} range.
result.notMeansBody: this is a screening, not a diagnosis. It does not label you with any condition, and it is not a substitute for a professional assessment.
result.inProgress: Your follow-up is in progress. A human navigator can see your case and its deadline.

why.minimal: Your score is in the minimal range (0-4). Most people at this level do well with self-help and a routine check-in.
why.mild: Your score is in the mild range (5-9). Self-help plus community support usually helps at this level; a navigator checks in within 14 days.
why.moderate: Your score is in the moderate range (10-14). Talking to a professional is recommended; you should be contacted within 7 days.
why.moderately_severe: Your score is in the moderately severe range. Specialist support is recommended: a human navigator contacts you within 24 hours and an appointment is arranged within 72 hours.
why.severe: Your score is in the severe range. Specialist support is recommended: a human navigator contacts you within 24 hours and an appointment is arranged within 72 hours.
why.crisis: Your answers suggest you may be at immediate risk. A human will help you right now — this is a fixed safety rule, not an automated judgement about your health.

sla.moderately_severe: Navigator contact within 24 hours; appointment within 72 hours.
sla.severe: Navigator contact within 24 hours; appointment within 72 hours.

specialist.handoff: Navigator calls within 24 hours, books the specialist appointment within 72 hours, and stays with you until you attend.

explain.title: Plain-language explanation
explain.aiLabel: AI-assisted wording — the result itself is computed by fixed rules, never by AI.

resident.title: How are you feeling?
resident.intro: Two short, validated questionnaires. One question at a time, about 2 minutes each. This is a screening, not a diagnosis. No name or ID number is needed — you get a pseudonymous ID.
resident.noneYet: No screenings yet. Your results and follow-up steps will appear here.
resident.consentOff: Storing your results is currently turned off, so past results are hidden. You can turn it back on in Privacy & consent.
resident.consentLink: Privacy & consent — control what is stored and shared
resident.deviceNote: Your pseudonymous ID is stored on this device only.

consent.title: Privacy & consent
consent.intro: Everything is off by default except what a specific action needs. Changes take effect immediately and are recorded in your audit log below.
consent.noResident: No screenings on this device yet. Complete a screening first, then manage consent here.
consent.loadError: Could not load consent settings. Please try again.
consent.updateError: Could not update consent. Nothing was changed.
consent.auditHint: Every grant and revocation, newest first. This log is visible only to you.

store_results.title: Store my screening results
store_results.description: Needed to save your result and show your follow-up plan. Turned on automatically when you complete a screening; turn it off any time and your past results are immediately hidden.

navigator_contact.title: Let a human navigator contact me
navigator_contact.description: Allows a care navigator to reach out about your follow-up steps.

share_with_primary_care.title: Share a summary with my primary care
share_with_primary_care.description: Allows a one-page summary to be shared with your primary-care clinician.

anonymous_aggregate_stats.title: Include me in anonymous statistics
anonymous_aggregate_stats.description: Your data joins anonymous, aggregated counts only. Groups smaller than 10 are never shown.

wearable_signal.title: Use my wearable signals
wearable_signal.description: Allows sleep/activity signals to invite you to a check-in. Never used to diagnose.

emergency.title: You are not alone — help is available now

guidance.0: If you are in immediate danger, contact emergency services now using the placeholder numbers below (verified before any real deployment).
guidance.1: Stay with someone you trust, or move to a place where other people are nearby.
guidance.2: Put distance between yourself and anything you could use to hurt yourself.
guidance.3: Breathe slowly. What you are feeling can change — support helps.
guidance.4: A human care navigator has been alerted and will respond immediately.

emergency.humanAlertedBody: A CRITICAL case has been created in the navigator queue with an immediate response deadline. In this prototype the navigator console shows the alert; in a live deployment this would page the on-call human navigator.
emergency.footerNote: This is a screening, not a diagnosis. Fixed safety rules triggered this page — no AI decision was involved.

navigator.title: Navigator console
navigator.subtitle: Queue sorted by risk, then overdue time. Simulated clock:
navigator.emptyOverdue: No overdue cases — every SLA is currently met.
navigator.emptyAll: No cases yet. Cases appear here after a resident screens.

case.crisisTriggerKeyword: Crisis trigger: crisis keyword in free text (fixed rule)

health.title: Gap Finder — Health-System dashboard
health.intro: Where do people fall out of the pathway from screening to follow-up? Seeded synthetic dataset of {n} residents with deliberately injected gaps. All metrics come from SQL views; groups smaller than 10 are suppressed inside the views.
health.fairnessTitle: Fairness table — conversion vs the best group
health.fairnessNote: A group is flagged as a gap when its conversion is below 80% of the best group in the same dimension. Groups under 10 are hidden to protect privacy. Only residents who consented to anonymous aggregate statistics are counted.
health.whatIfIntro: Toggle an intervention to see a deterministic, simulated improvement on the language groups. This is a planning illustration — no real effect is measured or claimed.
health.interventionADesc: Simulates closing 60% of each language group's screen-to-match gap vs the best group.
health.interventionBDesc: Simulates closing 50% of each language group's booking-conversion gap.
health.simFootnote: Simulation, not a real result. Deterministic arithmetic on the seeded synthetic data; no model, no randomness.
health.error: Could not load dashboard data. Please try again.

employer.title: Employer view — anonymous aggregates only
employer.banner: No identifiable wellbeing data is ever shown to employers.
employer.note: Only anonymous counts are available on this page. Groups under 10 are hidden to protect privacy and shown as “<10”. Individual scores, cases and crisis information are never exposed here. Counts include only residents who consented to anonymous aggregate statistics.
employer.suppressedNotCounted: Suppressed groups are not counted here.
employer.suppressedTitle: Suppressed: fewer than 10 people in this group
employer.error: Could not load aggregate data. Please try again.

summary.title: Primary-care summary
summary.intro: A one-page summary you can print or share with your primary-care clinician. Available only with your consent.
summary.consentRequired: Sharing with primary care is currently turned off. Turn on “Share a summary with my primary care” to view this page.
summary.interoperable: Interoperability-ready export (FHIR-shaped QuestionnaireResponse / Observation). Not certified.
summary.error: Could not load the summary. Please try again.

wearable.title: Wearable check-in
wearable.simulatedNote: Simulated data; real wearable integration is future work.
wearable.intro: With your consent, sleep and activity signals are compared against your own baseline. A change only ever invites a check-in — it never diagnoses anything.
wearable.consentRequired: Wearable signals are currently turned off. Turn on “Use my wearable signals” to try the simulator.
wearable.error: Could not load wearable data. Please try again.
wearable.changedTitle: We noticed a change. Want to check in?
wearable.changedBody: Your recent sleep or activity is lower than your usual baseline. That can have many everyday causes. A short screening is a gentle way to check how you are doing.
wearable.noChange: No notable change from your baseline. No action needed.
wearable.insufficient: Not enough data yet to compare against your baseline. Load demo data to see how it works.
wearable.neverDiagnoses: This simulator never diagnoses, scores, or decides crisis. Screening invitations are its only output.
